label: Thursday evening, at sunset: Holmes and Watson walk slowly across the moor from the hollow
quote: Holmes and I walked slowly across the moor
note: The walk planned in ¶109, now told. The sun is beginning to sink behind the Mapleton stables.

label: Thursday evening: Colonel Ross and the Inspector turn back towards Straker's house
quote: He turned back with the Inspector

label: Thursday evening, a few minutes later: at the long hollow towards Mapleton, Holmes finds the horse's track
quote: a few more minutes brought us to the hollow in question

label: Thursday evening: across dry turf, the tracks are picked up again close to Mapleton, with a man's track beside the horse's
quote: only to pick them up once more quite close to Mapleton

label: Thursday evening: they follow the double track towards King's Pyland; Watson sees the tracks coming back
quote: we both followed along after it

label: Thursday evening: they follow the return track to the asphalt paving before the Mapleton gates
quote: It ended at the paving of asphalt which led up to the gates of the Mapleton stables

label: Thursday evening: at the Mapleton gates, the groom Dawson runs out, then Silas Brown strides out
quote: As we approached, a groom ran out from them

label: Thursday evening: Holmes goes in with Silas Brown to his parlour for twenty minutes; Watson waits
quote: Now, Mr. Brown, I am quite at your disposal.

label: Thursday evening, twenty minutes later, at dusk: Holmes and Brown reappear; Brown promises to follow instructions
quote: It was twenty minutes, and the reds had all faded into greys before Holmes and the trainer reappeared

label: Thursday evening: Holmes and Watson set off from Mapleton for King's Pyland
quote: we set off for King's Pyland

label: Monday–Tuesday night (Holmes's reading): the horse, alone, crosses the wet hollow towards Mapleton
quote: The track of a horse was plainly outlined in the soft earth
note: Holmes supposes that the horse broke away during or after the tragedy (¶114). The hollow 'must have been very wet on Monday night' (¶116). The text does not date the tracks more finely.

label: A man's track joins the horse's close to Mapleton; the two turn towards King's Pyland
quote: A man's track was visible beside the horse's
note: The tracks show the horse alone before this point (¶120–121).

label: The man and the horse come back again, ending at the asphalt before the Mapleton gates
quote: the same tracks coming back again in the opposite direction

label: Friday, five in the morning: a call on Silas Brown (Holmes's question to the groom)
quote: if I were to call at five o'clock to-morrow morning
note: Holmes puts it as a hypothetical question; the story does not say that he will call.

label: Brown carries out Holmes's instructions ("It shall be there") (promised)
note: Brown's promise; what he will do, and when, is not told.

label: Friday: Brown is to hear from Holmes (promised)
quote: you shall hear from me to-morrow
note: Holmes also says in ¶141 that he will write to Brown.
